body: Added a real lightning-crackle visual to Ghost's Q (Alien Frequency): in-flight jittered box-sliver crackle riding the projectile, plus a radiating impact burst fired off a projectile active->inactive edge-detect at the shot's last-known position. Both client-side only (apps/arena/src/main.c), reusing draw_hero_box_facing, no new draw primitive. Commit ce19053.
title: Ghost's Q lightning-crackle in-flight + impact visual
